title: HAPI Settings
description: Configuration file for HAPI (~/.hapi/settings.json, or $HAPI_HOME/settings.json). Shared by the hub and the CLI on the same machine. See https://hapi.run/docs/guide/configuration

cliApiToken.description: Shared secret for CLI authentication. Auto-generated if not set. ENV: CLI_API_TOKEN

apiUrl.description: Hub URL for CLI connections. ENV: HAPI_API_URL

extraHeaders.description: Extra headers for CLI to hub HTTP and WebSocket requests. ENV: HAPI_EXTRA_HEADERS_JSON

serverUrl.description: Legacy name for apiUrl. Read by the CLI only when apiUrl is absent.

listenHost.description: Hub HTTP bind address. ENV: HAPI_LISTEN_HOST

publicUrl.description: Public URL for external access. Must be the hub's canonical HTTPS origin (no path) for passkeys; also used for the Telegram Mini App and to derive default CORS origins. Default: http://localhost:<listenPort>. ENV: HAPI_PUBLIC_URL

corsOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins, or ["*"]. Default: derived from publicUrl. ENV: CORS_ORIGINS (comma-separated)

telegramBotToken.description: Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather. ENV: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

serverChanSendKey.description: ServerChan SendKey for WeChat push notifications. ENV: SERVERCHAN_SENDKEY

serverChanBackgroundOnly.description: Only send ServerChan notifications when no visible HAPI connection exists in the namespace. ENV: SERVERCHAN_BACKGROUND_ONLY

androidPushMode.description: Android push transport. auto: direct FCM when fcmServiceAccountPath is set, otherwise the official push relay. ENV: HAPI_ANDROID_PUSH

fcmServiceAccountPath.description: Firebase service-account JSON for direct FCM (private builds using the same Firebase project). ENV: FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH

iosPushMode.description: iOS push transport. apns requires apnsKeyP8Path, apnsKeyId, apnsTeamId and apnsBundleId. ENV: HAPI_IOS_PUSH

iosPushRelayUrl.description: Shared Android/iOS native push relay URL (independent of the --relay network tunnel). ENV: HAPI_PUSH_RELAY_URL

apnsKeyP8Path.description: Path to the APNs .p8 auth key for direct APNs. ENV: APNS_KEY_P8_PATH

apnsKeyId.description: APNs key ID for direct APNs. ENV: APNS_KEY_ID

apnsTeamId.description: Apple developer team ID for direct APNs. ENV: APNS_TEAM_ID

apnsBundleId.description: iOS app bundle ID (APNs topic) for direct APNs. ENV: APNS_BUNDLE_ID

apnsEnv.description: APNs environment for direct APNs. ENV: APNS_ENV

relayAuthKey.description: Per-hub relay auth key issued by the relay server. Auto-obtained if not set. ENV: HAPI_RELAY_AUTH

vapidKeys.description: Auto-generated Web Push VAPID keys. Do not edit manually.

machineId.description: Auto-generated unique machine identifier. Do not edit manually.

machineIdConfirmedByServer.description: Internal flag. Do not edit manually.

runnerAutoStartWhenRunningHappy.description: Legacy field; currently not read by HAPI.

sessionSummaryContract.description: Inject the AGENT_NOTIFY_SUMMARY trailing-line contract into supported agents' instructions. Editable in web Settings. CLI env HAPI_SESSION_SUMMARY_CONTRACT overrides per process.

followUpDefault.description: Hub-wide delivery default for interactive follow-up messages.

sessionSummaryInChat.description: Show a compact AGENT_NOTIFY_SUMMARY row in web chat instead of stripping the footer. Editable in web Settings.

autoBridgeTransientModelErrors.description: Cursor sessions automatically enqueue a one-shot bridge after a transient model error. Editable in web Settings.

peerSpawnDefaults.description: Hub-wide defaults for spawn_peer / hapi spawn-peer. Unset fields fall back to agent=claude, permissionMode=yolo, models={claude: sonnet}. Editable in web Settings.

agent.description: Default agent flavor for spawned peers.

permissionMode.description: Default permission intent; mapped to an equivalent mode the target agent supports.

models.description: Per-agent model overrides keyed by agent flavor, e.g. {"claude": "sonnet"}.

elevenLabsMaxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum length of one ElevenLabs voice conversation, in seconds. Editable in web Settings. ENV ELEVENLABS_MAX_DURATION_SECONDS wins when set.

providerCredentials.description: Hub-managed voice and dictation provider credentials, keyed by env var name (OPENAI_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, TRANSCRIPTION_BASE_URL, TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL, TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, QWEN_API_KEY). Managed from web Settings; process environment variables win over settings-backed values.
